description.value:
Aspect Half-Light

Cost Focus 1

Melee touch — this doesn't age flesh, only metal. Make a melee spell attack roll against the item's AC (an unwilling wielder may instead attempt a Reflex save to snatch it clear). Success the item corrodes, taking a permanent −1 item penalty until repaired by a smith (1 hour, Crafting DC equal to the item's level). Critical Success as success, but the penalty is −2. This penalty does not stack past −2 from repeated castings.

target.value: 1 creature's worn armor or held metal weapon

cinderfall.incomplete: Permanent item penalty to a hostile target's own worn armor/held weapon -- ItemAlteration only alters items owned by the same actor the rule element's item belongs to; no rule element alters a hostile target's own gear (NOFOREIGN-ITEM).
